scientific_integrity: General proof is constructive and characteristic-independent; exhaustive finite checker is supplementary; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies torus-fixed-point maximal-cone facet profiles, not positive-dimensional singular locus or analytic local types. Related literature may be indexed under simplicial graphic-arrangement chambers. All-length-two K_{2,t} specialization and general Hasse-tree criterion are known; finite computations corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem.
title: Chamber-facet profiles of generalized-theta graphical-zonotope toric varieties
